title: MicroPetal: The Uno Has Left the Chat

scenes.eyebrow: THE UNO HAS LEFT THE CHAT
scenes.title:
Same silhouette.
Plot twist inside.
labels: Not another victory lap over an 8-bit chip
cues: The ATmega three twenty-eight P is a legend. It taught a generation to blink an L E D, and fear the words: low memory.
Micro Petal keeps the Uno shape, but swaps the engine. No, beating an eight-bit chip is not breaking news. The interesting bit is what you can build.

scenes.title:
Less memory Tetris.
More project.
cues: Sixteen K of RAM instead of two. A hundred and twenty-eight K of flash instead of thirty-two.
Bigger buffers. More room for your code. Fewer evenings deleting helpful error messages to fit the helpful error messages.

scenes.title:
32-bit brain.
Less babysitting.
labels: DMA can move data without CPU copying
cues: A thirty-two-bit Cortex M zero plus, and D M A hardware that can move data without the processor copying every byte.
The chip is rated up to seventy-two megahertz. Our experimental core starts at eight. Datasheets are not benchmarks. Neither is this video.

scenes.title:
Keep the sketch.
Lose the nostalgia tax.
cues: The experimental Arduino core and Platform I O give you a familiar place to start. Open hardware and source give you somewhere to go.
This is a project you can inspect and change, not a magic box with a subscribe button.

scenes.eyebrow: THE FINE PRINT HAS ENTERED THE CHAT
scenes.title:
Same shape.
Not a free pass.
labels: UART TX is D2, not D1
Before power: follow the JP3 guide
cues: There is fine print. Three point three volt logic. Check your shields. Serial transmit is D two, not D one. Follow the power jumper guide.
Familiar shape does not mean electrically identical. Smoke remains a terrible debugging interface.

scenes.eyebrow: BUILD SOMETHING WORTH THE EXTRA ROOM
scenes.title:
MicroPetal.
Bigger plans.
labels: F071 first · F072 hardware option only
cues: The F zero seventy-one comes first. The F zero seventy-two is a board option, not finished software support.
The code builds. Physical testing is next. Old Uno, take a bow. Micro Petal: let's build something that needs the extra room.
